evals.prompt: 我需要在我们的 webserver 项目里加一个新 service，处理数据导出任务的进度跟踪和结果存储。项目现有结构是 pkg/service/signalbox、pkg/service/exporttask、pkg/handler/accesscontrol、pkg/repository/mysql 这种风格，service 层一般是 unexported struct + New 构造函数 + interface。帮我新建这个 service：接口定义、实现、构造函数、相关 types。所有代码文件写到 outputs/ 目录下（按 go package 结构组织）。
evals.expected_output: A well-named Go service package: singular lowercase package name matching sibling style, types that don't stutter the package name, short consistent receivers, sibling-matching file names, unexported struct + New constructor, no DTO suffixes, no Get-prefix accessors.
expectations: The new package name is a single lowercase word with no underscores or mixedCaps (e.g. 'exportprogress' or 'exporttask' style, NOT 'export_progress' or 'ExportProgress')
No exported type name stutters the package name (if package is 'exportprogress', no type like 'ExportProgressStatus' — should be 'Status')
Every method receiver is at most 2 characters and the same receiver name is used for all methods of a given type
No zero-argument Get-prefixed accessor methods exist (no 'GetStatus()', 'GetResult()'); accessor methods, if any, are named after the field
The service implementation struct is unexported and constructed via an exported New function
No type names end with DTO, VO, Entity, or Bean suffixes
Go file names use snake_case and no file is named exactly after its package directory (no pkg/pkg.go style)
No package or directory named util, utils, common, helper, helpers, types, or misc appears

evals.prompt: 帮我写一些通用的 go 工具函数：格式化时间、生成 ULID 格式的 event id、字符串 slice 去重、读环境变量带默认值。放到一个 package 里就行，代码写到 outputs 目录。
evals.expected_output: Should NOT create one util/helpers/common grab-bag package. Either split into focused packages (ids, timefmt, envx, strx) or justify a single package named for what it provides. Correct acronym casing (ID, ULID), noun variables without type suffixes, no Get prefixes.
expectations: No package declaration is named util, utils, utilities, helper, helpers, common, misc, tools, base, or shared
All identifiers use correct acronym casing: ID and ULID appear all-caps; no 'Id', 'Ulid', 'Uid', 'Url', or 'Json' style miscased acronyms in hand-written identifiers
No function names use a redundant Get prefix (no GetEnvDefault/GetFormattedTime style; names like EnvOrDefault or FormatTime expected)
No variable or parameter names encode their type with Slice/Map/Array/Int/String suffixes (e.g. no 'idSlice', 'strList', 'envString')

If the helpers are split across packages, each package name says what it provides (e.g. ids, timefmt, envx); if kept in one package, the choice is explicitly justified and the name is still not a grab-bag word

evals.prompt: 我有个现有的 repository 类型，要加两个方法：根据 user id 查 session 列表、按 url 查一条推送记录；再加一个 sentinel error 表示记录名冲突。另外写个转换函数，把 proto 生成的 pb.SessionRecord（生成出来的 go 字段是 UserId、SourceUrl、CardJson）转成我的 domain struct。新代码写到 outputs 目录。
evals.expected_output: Receiver must be 'r' (matching existing code) on ALL new methods. Domain struct fields UserID, SourceURL, CardJSON; proto casing confined to the converter. Sentinel error ErrXxx form. No this/self receivers. No type-encoded names.
expectations: Every new method on the repository type uses the receiver name 'r', matching the existing GetBusinessLine method — no 'repository', 'repo', 'this', or 'self' receivers
The hand-written domain struct uses correctly-cased acronym fields: UserID, SourceURL, CardJSON (not UserId, SourceUrl, CardJson)
Proto-generated style identifiers (UserId, SourceUrl, CardJson) appear ONLY inside the converter function/file, never in domain struct definitions or method signatures
The sentinel error for record-name conflict follows the ErrXxx pattern (e.g. ErrRecordNameConflict) — not ErrorXxx, XxxError, and not used for a numeric code
Method and local variable names do not encode types (no 'sessionList', 'userSlice', 'recordMap')
The converter maps each proto field to its correctly-cased domain field, with both casings visible in the same function (the mapper-firewall pattern)

evals.prompt: 帮我给 workspace service 加个功能：触发 runtime 重启（后台异步执行，真正重启开个 goroutine 做），再加一个查询当前有没有重启在进行中的方法，没有就返回 false。代码写到 outputs 目录。
evals.expected_output: The restart-triggering method must be named as an action (RequestRuntimeRestart / TriggerRestart), never as a noun or Get-style getter — a name like RestartResult() hides that it spawns a goroutine. The in-progress check must be a predicate (IsRestartInProgress / HasActiveRestart) or Find/Lookup, not GetX. The goroutine-spawning function must not use pure vocabulary (Get/Compute/Validate). Async behavior documented in the doc comment.
expectations: The method that triggers the restart uses an action verb (Request*/Trigger*/Restart*) and is NOT named as a noun or Get-style getter (no RestartResult(), GetRestart(), RestartStatus() for the action)
The in-progress check is named as a predicate (Is*/Has*) returning bool, or as Find*/Lookup* — not GetX
No function that spawns a goroutine or mutates state uses pure-query vocabulary (Get*/Compute*/Validate*/Format*)
The doc comment on the async action method states that it runs asynchronously / spawns work in the background
All receivers are at most 2 characters and consistent per type

evals.expected_output: Methods with the comma-ok absence shape must be named Find*/Lookup*, not Get* — Get promises present-or-error. If the agent keeps Get names it must switch absence to an error (ErrXxxNotFound). Sentinel error must be ErrXxxNotFound with Err prefix. New methods reuse the interface's existing vocabulary (Save/List already there).
expectations: The comma-ok methods (returning (T, bool, error)) are named Find* or Lookup* — not Get* (Get with a bool absence outcome is a contract violation)
If any method named Get* exists, its absence handling is error-based (ErrXxxNotFound), not (zero-value, false, nil)
The sentinel error for a missing run follows the ErrXxx pattern (e.g. ErrWorkflowRunNotFound) — lowercase unpunctuated error string
No interface or type names use an I prefix or Interface suffix; no package-name stutter in type names
New method names reuse the existing vocabulary family (Save/List verbs already present; no gratuitous new synonyms like Store/Persist for the same operations)

evals.prompt: 这个 service 已有方法：FetchReport(ctx, id) (*Report, error)（走远程 HTTP）、AcquireLease(ctx, key) (Lease, error)、ReleaseLease(ctx, lease) error。现在要加：1) 查询远端一个 report 的所有历史版本（也是 HTTP 调用）2) 丢弃一个坏掉的 lease 3) 一个布尔配置项控制是否自动重试。写到一个文件里加到现有类型上，代码写到 outputs（可以包含现有方法的 stub）。
evals.expected_output: New remote fetch must reuse the existing verb Fetch* (not Get*/Retrieve*/Obtain*/Load*). Lease teardown must announce the teardown effect (Release* or a documented distinct verb like Discard* for the broken-lease path — with a comment stating the contract difference). The boolean option must be positive (WithAutoRetry / IsAutoRetryEnabled), not negated (no DisableAutoRetry/NoRetry).
expectations: The new remote-history method reuses the existing verb Fetch* (e.g. FetchReportVersions), not Get*/Retrieve*/Obtain*/Load*
The lease teardown method's name announces the teardown effect (Release*/Discard*/Drop*) — not a generic verb (Handle*/Process*/Do*) or a bare noun
If teardown introduces a verb distinct from the existing Release* (e.g. DiscardLease), a doc comment states the contract difference between the two verbs
The boolean retry option is named positively (WithAutoRetry / AutoRetry / IsAutoRetryEnabled) — no negated name (DisableAutoRetry, NoRetry, WithoutRetry)
Doc comments on the remote methods signal the HTTP/remote-call cost

evals.prompt: 我要起一个全新的小 CLI 项目：从本地读一组 CSV 文件、按指定列去重、把合并结果输出成 JSON。帮我搭好初始结构：go.mod、一个读 CSV 的 package、一个负责去重和写 JSON 的 package、以及 cmd 下的入口。去重列的索引、输出缓冲区大小这些用常量定义。所有代码写到 outputs/ 目录（按 go package 结构组织）。
evals.expected_output: A fresh module whose import path is a host/path you'd plausibly own (github.com/.../csvdedup), not a bare word. Packages named for what they provide, avoiding names that collide with stdlib or common local vars (no package 'csv' shadowing encoding/csv, no 'util'/'buf' grab-bag). Constants named by role (defaultBufferSize, dedupColumnIndex), never single letters. Core functions named to reveal intent (action verbs), not opaque generics.
expectations: The go.mod module path is host/path form with a dot in the first segment (e.g. github.com/.../csvdedup, example.com/.../csvdedup) — NOT a bare word like 'csv', 'csvdedup', 'app', 'mymodule', or 'tool'

No package is named 'csv' (shadows encoding/csv), 'buf', 'util', 'utils', 'common', 'helper', 'helpers', 'misc', 'base', or 'shared' — packages are named for what they provide (e.g. csvread, dedup, csvio)
No single-letter constant declarations appear (no 'const c =', 'const i =', 'const n =' etc.) — constants are named by role (defaultBufferSize, dedupColumnIndex)
No SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE constants and no K-prefixed constants (no MAX_BUFFER_SIZE, KBufferSize)

The core dedup/output functions use intention-revealing action verbs (Dedup/Merge/WriteJSON/Export) — not opaque single-letter or generic names (Do/Handle/Process/Run as the only name for the core logic)
